mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant electrolyte wasting (especially potassium and magnesium) and nephrotoxicity, while bisacodyl-induced diarrhea may exacerbate fluid and electrolyte losses, increasing hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes closely, particularly potassium and magnesium; consider alternative laxatives and ensure adequate electrolyte supplementation during concurrent use.
